one.title: Innovate, connect, transform.
one.text: Tarico simplifies business management in Africa with powerful, accessible, and secure digital tools.

rethink.title: Innovate
rethink.text: At Tarico, innovation is at the heart of our solutions. We are rethinking how African businesses manage their data and processes, introducing simple, effective digital tools adapted to local challenges. Innovation helps address the unique challenges of each market, thereby providing true added value.

innovate.title: Connect
innovate.text: Tarico facilitates the connection between economic players, employees, and information systems through its digital solutions. By connecting different services and users within a company, we improve collaboration and the fluidity of exchanges, which are essential for optimal management.

reconcile.title: Transform
reconcile.text: We believe that digital transformation is the key to propelling African businesses into the future. Thanks to our powerful tools, companies can transition from traditional to modern, automated, and more efficient management, while promoting sustainable and inclusive growth.

three.text: At Tarico, user experience isn't just a criterion—it's a foundation. Every feature, every interface, every line of code is designed for one thing: to make our software use fluid, natural, and efficient. We firmly believe that good software is invisible—it disappears behind the simplicity of use and the effectiveness it brings.

meta.description: The ambition to transform Africa through digitalization

header.title: The ambition to transform Africa through digitalization
header.description: At Codia, we simplify data management for businesses by offering innovative digital solutions that facilitate the access, analysis, and effective use of their information.

summary.text:
At Codia, we are transforming how companies interact with their customers. Specialists in tailored digital solutions, we reinvent traditional processes to create powerful, intuitive, and effective tools.

Our goal is clear: to connect businesses with their customers more intelligently, focusing on modern technologies and a flawless user experience. Codia is the alliance of innovation and simplicity for performance.

cover.title: A software suite designed for efficiency
cover.text: At Tarico, every piece of software is born from a need identified in the field. We have listened to our users, understood their roadblocks, and developed tools that precisely address their challenges. Our software suite is the result of a practical vision, designed to be quickly operational and truly useful every day.

header.title: Your next great career change
header.summary:
At Codia, we don't just create, we innovate.
We don't just work, we collaborate.
We don't have offices, we have a playground.

object.text: At Codia, our ambition is clear: to become the undisputed leader in digitalization in Africa. We firmly believe in the continent's immense potential and are committed to transforming African businesses through innovative, adapted, and accessible digital solutions. By rethinking traditional processes, relentlessly innovating, and bringing businesses and customers closer, we aim to set new standards for a prosperous digital future in Africa. Codia is not just a player in digitalization; we are a driver of change and growth for an entire continent.
object.subtext: We want to surround ourselves with the best to achieve our goals. Ready for a challenge (and ready for an adventure)? Join us.

whyWorkWithUs.title: Many reasons to love working with us

valuables.title: We are optimistic
valuables.text: We believe that anything is possible and that we can do incredible things. We believe we have an exciting future ahead of us. We appreciate this journey we're on together and we seek enjoyment in what we do. We always assume good intentions, and we deeply value kindness and empathy.

valuables.title: We are confident, yet humble
valuables.text: We believe in ourselves and truly love learning as individuals and as a team. We are curious by nature and we ask a lot of questions – we never assume we have all the answers. We give and receive feedback openly and honestly. We embrace a growth mindset and are constantly looking for ways to be better.

valuables.title: We are obsessed with our clients' success
valuables.text: We love solving our clients' biggest, most urgent, and most valuable problems. We measure and are obsessed with delivering meaningful results and value for our clients and continuously improving our abilities to do so even more in the future.

valuables.title: We think big and start small
valuables.text: We love tackling big problems, and we love breaking them down into solvable pieces. Our ambition pushes us to go beyond what's thought possible. We start with the problem to be solved in everything we do. We invest in long-term building and we learn through short-term experimentation.

valuables.title: We go further together
valuables.text: We work as one team, we win as one team. We've set the bar high for ourselves and for others. We respect each other and we seek different perspectives to find the best way forward. We look out for one another, we lift one another up, and we ensure there are equitable opportunities for all to succeed.

valuables.title: For us, every day counts
valuables.text: We start each day with a clear goal, an intention to make an impact. We don't wait for the right time, we create it. We fight to unblock ourselves, we push to make progress, and we work hard with a sense of urgency and focus.

hero.title0: The smart solution for effective and compliant HR management.
hero.title: Less admin, more growth: that's Tarico HR
hero.description:
Most companies still manage their human resources on paper or through heavy manual processes. The result: piles of archives, data that's hard to find, and costly errors.

With Tarico HR, everything changes.
We transform HR management into a fluid, digital, and strategic process.
From contract management to leave, compliance, and reporting, you centralize everything in a single secure and intuitive platform.

You save time, reduce costs related to repetitive tasks, and finally say goodbye to administrative blockages. Whether you're a growing startup or a multinational, Tarico HR adapts to your needs and supports your transition to modern and efficient management.

advantage.title:
Simplify your processes,
secure your data,
engage your teams.
advantage.description: With Tarico HR, you have a unique solution that transforms HR management into a real strategic lever.

items.title: Save time every day
items.text: Automate repetitive tasks (contracts, leave, reporting) and focus on what truly matters: your employees.

items.title: Secure your HR data
items.text: Benefit from a system compliant with international standards, with advanced encryption and strict access control.

items.title: Easy to use, quick to adopt
items.text: An intuitive interface and fluid integration with your existing tools promote immediate adoption by the entire organization.

funcs.title: What Tarico HR does for you, in 4 essential points
funcs.description: Discover the essential modules that transform your HR management into a fluid and efficient process.

features.title: A clear vision of your teams
features.text: Centralize all employee information with a hierarchical and operational unit organization, for structured and effective management.

features.title: Simplify contract management
features.text: Easily create and track all your contracts (permanent, fixed-term, internship, daily) with ready-to-use templates and automatic alerts.

features.title: Gain fluidity with leave management
features.text: Submit, validate, and track leave and absences in real time, without paperwork or delays.

features.title: Make informed decisions
features.text: Automatic generation of legal reports and interactive dashboards for dynamic and compliant monitoring.

intro.title: Tarico HR is tangible: time saved, costs reduced, and more visibility.
intro.text: Measurable benefits that transform your day-to-day HR management.

items.title: 30% savings
items.text: Reduce costs related to errors and paper management.

items.title: +40% time saved
items.text: Automate your HR processes and focus on what's essential.

items.title: 100% visibility
items.text: Reliable, real-time data to make decisions faster.

services.title: Even more value for your HR teams
services.text: Beyond the essential modules, Tarico HR integrates advanced features and an ambitious roadmap that enrich your management.

features.title: Leave & absences
features.text: Employees easily submit their requests and managers validate them with one click, for simple, fast, and traceable absence management.

features.title: Social report & reporting
features.text: Automatically generate your social and HR reports, facilitate your audits, and make informed decisions thanks to interactive dashboards.

features.title: Health & medical files
features.text: Centralize and secure medical certificates and visits to ensure employee well-being and compliance with legal obligations.

features.title: Time & activities
features.text: Plan tasks, track team productivity, and get ready for digital time tracking for a precise and modern monitoring of working time.

features.title: Workgroup
features.text: Allow for flexible and hierarchical structuring of the internal organization with Tarico HR.

features.title: Exchange
features.text: Easily and securely share and exchange files between employees.

features.title: Activity reports
features.text: Give employees the possibility to write and submit their activity reports for better performance monitoring.

features.title: Personnel evaluation
features.text: 360° evaluations and objective tracking to develop skills and support your employees.

features.title: Hiring & recruitment
features.text: From posting offers to tracking applications, manage all your recruitment directly in Tarico HR.

access.title: A simple process to adopt Tarico HR
access.text: Three steps are enough to set up your platform and start benefiting from it.

steps.title: Schedule a meeting with our sales team
steps.text: Schedule a meeting with our sales team. In just one exchange, we deploy your complete environment within 30 minutes of the meeting's end.

steps.title: Receive your access via email
steps.text: Following the deployment, you will receive all the necessary information to access your platform directly via email.

steps.title: Add your employees and fully benefit from Tarico HR
steps.text: Add your new recruits as well as your current employees, and leverage all the features of Tarico HR to optimize your workforce management.

intro.title: Ready to transform your HR management?
intro.text: Digitize your processes, save time, and focus on what's essential: your company's growth.

contract.title: Create, manage, and track your employment contracts with ease.
contract.text: Manage the entire lifecycle of your employment contracts from a simple and intuitive interface. Create your documents in a few clicks, track their status in real time, and ensure they comply with local legislation. With Tarico HR, save time, reduce errors, and centralize all your contractual data in one place.

features.title: Fast and simple contract creation
features.text: Create your employment contracts in a few clicks with ready-to-use templates.

features.title: Personalize your templates
features.text: Easily adapt your contract templates to your company's specific needs.

features.title: Receive alerts on contract status
features.text: Be informed in real time of the progress and status changes of your contracts.

contact.title: Responsive 24/7 support so your HR never stops
contact.text: Our team is available at any time to answer your questions, solve your problems, and support you in your human resources management.

description.text:
Tarico HR is a smart and intuitive platform, designed to support African and international companies in the digitalization, structuring, and optimization of their HR processes.

Whether you are a small or medium-sized enterprise, a large company, or a multi-site organization, TARICO HR adapts to your field reality, with powerful and modular tools, integrated into a secure digital ecosystem.

domutala.name: Mamadou DIA, CEO and Product Manager
domutala.text: Founder and CEO of Codia, an HRIS expert, Mamadou brings real added value to clients thanks to his expertise in developing solutions adapted to the specific needs of businesses. He ensures that each solution meets performance and innovation requirements.

speedy.name: Saliou DIOP, Marketing and Sales Director, co-founder
speedy.text: Saliou leads the Codia marketing team, including product marketing, corporate marketing, demand generation, and growth. He was the Executive Director of African Management Service.

saer.name: Saër, Director of Production and co-founder
saer.text: Saër leads research and development, particularly with the product, engineering, and design teams. He has worked at Attijari Bank in Morocco and Acep Senegal.

ceo.text: At Codia, we build tools that facilitate digital integration across the continent. And that starts with understanding new user requirements. We produce the best tools for a better user experience.

01.title: Leave & Absence Management
01.description: Thanks to automated leave and absence management, TARICO HR simplifies the processes related to leave requests. Employees can easily submit their leave requests, while managers validate with a single click.

02.title: Social Report & HR Dashboards
02.description: The social report is automatically generated, providing you with a detailed report on the company's HR situation, which facilitates internal or external audits and the preparation of legal reports.

03.title: Medical Records & Occupational Health Monitoring
03.description: The centralization of employee health data is essential to ensure their well-being and comply with legal obligations. TARICO HR allows you to securely track medical visits, medical certificates, and health records.

04.title: T&A (Time & Activities Management)
04.description: TARICO HR simplifies the management of working hours, task planning, and employee productivity tracking. Thanks to digital time tracking, which will be available very soon, employees can easily record their working hours.

05.title: Significant time savings
05.description: By automating repetitive and time-consuming HR processes, your teams can reallocate their time to higher-value missions, such as talent development or your company's HR strategy.

06.title: Strategic and informed HR decisions
06.description: Real-time access to strategic data allows you to make more informed and reactive decisions. This improves your talent management and optimizes your long-term HR strategy.
